parsedVerdict.reasoning: ProjectService is a plain application-layer use-case service. It coordinates domain objects: it creates projects through the domain factory and stores and loads them through an injected repository port. It gets ids and timestamps from injected ports and maps results to DTOs. It has no persistence code, transport or HTTP handling, or framework logic. The only conditional is a not-found check that raises a domain error. That is ordinary use-case orchestration, not a business rule that belongs in the domain layer. Every responsibility fits the application layer.
